test.prompt: Use the configured Notion MCP tools. First fetch the configured Projects source at {{source}}. Then create one private page titled '[Company OS connection test {{run_id}}] Projects', fetch that new page, archive it after the read-back succeeds, and report the source identity, created page ID and URL, exact fetched title, and cleanup result. Do not change any existing workspace content.
test.expected_output: The configured Projects source is readable and one isolated private page is created, fetched with the exact title, and archived.
assertions: The configured Projects source is fetched successfully.
The response reports one created Notion page ID and URL.
The created page is fetched after creation and its title exactly matches the requested title.
The test page is archived and no existing workspace content is changed.

readiness.prompt: Use only read-only Notion MCP tools. Fetch the configured Projects source at {{source}} and inspect its schema plus a bounded sample of at most 10 records. Report structure and counts only; do not quote record content or make changes.

test.prompt: Use the configured Linear MCP tools. Fetch the configured Projects source or test team at {{source}}, create exactly one issue titled '[Company OS connection test {{run_id}}] Projects', fetch the issue after creation, mark it cancelled or otherwise non-active after the read-back succeeds, and report its ID, URL, title, team, read-back result, and cleanup result. Do not change any existing issue.
test.expected_output: The configured Linear source is readable and one isolated issue is created, fetched with matching identity, and left non-active.
assertions: The configured Linear source or team is fetched successfully.
The response reports one created issue ID and URL.
The issue is fetched after creation and its title and team match.
The test issue is left non-active and no existing issue is changed.

readiness.prompt: Use only read-only Linear MCP tools. Fetch the configured Projects source or team at {{source}} and inspect its schema plus a bounded sample of at most 10 projects. Report structure and counts only; do not quote record content or make changes.
